# construct translated arrangement from the port-matching chain
objs = {
'7': {'color':7, 'origin':(1,15), 'cells':[(0,c) for c in range(6)], 'ports':[(1,0),(1,5)]},
'5': {'color':5, 'origin':(8,15), 'cells':[(0,c) for c in range(6)]+[(1,0),(1,5),(2,5),(3,3),(3,4),(3,5)], 'ports':[(-1,1),(-1,4),(2,0),(3,2)]},
'8': {'color':8, 'origin':(3,15), 'cells':[(0,c) for c in range(6)]+[(1,1),(1,4),(2,1),(2,4),(3,1),(3,4)], 'ports':[(-1,0),(-1,5),(4,1),(4,4)]},
'4': {'color':4, 'origin':(11,12), 'cells':[(r,c) for r in range(4) for c in range(5)], 'ports':[(-1,3),(0,5),(3,-1),(4,4)]},
'3': {'color':3, 'origin':(17,6), 'cells':[(0,0),(0,1),(0,2),(1,0),(2,0),(2,4)]+[(3,c) for c in range(5)], 'ports':[(-1,0),(-1,2),(0,3),(1,4)]},
'1a': {'color':1, 'origin':(14,10), 'cells':[(0,0),(1,0),(2,0),(2,6)]+[(3,c) for c in range(7)], 'ports':[(0,1),(1,6),(3,-1),(4,0)]},
'1b': {'color':1, 'origin':(14,6), 'cells':[(0,0),(0,1),(0,2),(1,0),(1,2)], 'ports':[(2,0),(2,2)]},
}
grid=[[0]*26 for _ in range(26)]
placements={}
for name,o in objs.items():
    r0,c0=o['origin']
    for dr,dc in o['cells']:
        r,c=r0+dr,c0+dc
        assert 0<=r<26 and 0<=c<26,(name,r,c)
        assert grid[r][c] in (0,o['color']),(name,r,c,grid[r][c])
        grid[r][c]=o['color']
    for dr,dc in o['ports']:
        r,c=r0+dr,c0+dc
        assert 0<=r<26 and 0<=c<26,(name,'port',r,c)
        assert grid[r][c] in (0,2),(name,'port clash cell',r,c,grid[r][c])
        grid[r][c]=2
    placements[name]=o['origin']
print(placements)
for row in grid: print(' '.join(map(str,row)))
print('counts', {v:sum(x==v for row in grid for x in row) for v in range(10)})
